entities.name: CoaBC bifunctional enzyme
observations: The 395-aa query has 48.7% identity and 98.5% coverage to reviewed Escherichia coli CoaBC (UniProt P0ABQ0/P0ABQ1).
Query Pfam profile hits support the two-part CoaBC architecture: flavoprotein domain PF02441 at residues 3–177 and DFP domain PF04127 at residues 184–391.
Likely catalyzes phosphopantothenate:cysteine ligation (EC 6.3.2.5) and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation (EC 4.1.1.36), supporting coenzyme A biosynthesis.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: CoaBC performs two consecutive steps downstream of pantothenate: formation of 4-phosphopantothenoylcysteine followed by its decarboxylation to 4'-phosphopantetheine.
